name: @watermark/site
description: The Watermark public site — an Astro + MDX frontend over the committed content bundle (Epic #54). The Astro app package in the pnpm workspace (Epic #1549, Phase 5 #1555): pages, layouts, the residual site components, plugins, config, middleware, and content. Depends on @watermark/{core,charts,viz} (and @watermark/functions for the local dev stack); all shared domain/chart/island/Functions code lives in those packages.

scripts.check: astro check && pnpm run check:functions && pnpm run check:core && pnpm run check:charts && pnpm run check:viz
scripts.lint: biome ci src functions scripts packages
scripts.format: biome check --write src functions scripts packages
